BREEZE 2027 / PRIVATE REVIEW

Natural cave entrance and rocky tunnel

C9 and approved3× sampling preserved. Private candidate only; NOT production-ready. Engineered entrance collar and thin scan edges remain visible; seven exact artist images are pending. No visible fixtures or giant entrance lettering. Inherited C9 visibility defects and physical-device acceptance remain outstanding. No public promotion or deployment.
